h1: Four clear hooks, no proven buyer yet
room_line: Separate eligibility, awareness and paid conversion before the room turns campaign visibility into demand.
coming_kick: GHOSTHING offers the most distinctive engagement-shaped signal; BAPAK PALING JUJUR has broader curiosity potential; DENDAM ARWAH PENARI carries the weakest conversion case.
coming_caveat: Private eligibility, bookings and purchase-proximate evidence remain unresolved for every incoming title.
signal_note: Public samples differ in scope: compare signal shapes, not cross-title view ratios. One popular post is neither demand nor session-timing evidence.

coming.lvlx: Clear hook; demand and eligibility unproven

eligibility.basis: The title appears on the SAMS public Coming surface with is_approved=true, but that public indication is discovery evidence only and is not private booking, DCP or final ordinary-eligibility confirmation. No explicit current Akhil or Programming confirmation was supplied.

coming.meta: Junior Roberts, Dosma Hazenbosch and NIH Pictures: Della Dartyan, Ruth Marini, Aldo Irawan Putra and Aulia Deas support; LSF identifies the legal production entity as PT. Nirwana Indah Hakarya.
coming.logline: A grieving man uses a mysterious application to reconnect with his murdered girlfriend, but instead admits a malevolent force that exploits his grief and desire for revenge.
coming.quality: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the strongest adjacent account calls it tense through the ending and describes psychological horror plus action-thriller, but no clearly independent critic or audience review validates that assessment.
coming.gold: Accessible digital-horror hook: an app connecting the living and dead gives the film a contemporary premise, while romance, revenge and action broaden the pitch; the 17+ rating narrows the addressable audience.
coming.promo: Active but localized campaign: NIH Pictures released trailer and poster, Dimas Anggara and Dosma Hazenbosch attended a Palembang special screening, and gala-premiere content appeared immediately before release.
coming.social: Visible but campaign-led social response: ten captured TikTok results total 11,029 views, 319 likes, seven comments and 93 shares; one post supplies 90 of the shares, and the sample contains little organic audience discussion.
coming.demand: Demand remains insufficient evidence: release-date posts say to add the title to a TIX ID watchlist or secure tickets, but the bundle contains no bookable showtime, presale volume, seat map, sell-out or paid-admission signal.
coming.risk: Programming risk outweighs the public signal: private SAMS ordinary eligibility remains unconfirmed, purchase demand is absent, quality is unvalidated and the 17+ rating limits reach despite an active campaign.
coming.bet: If eligible, a prime Day-1 show reaches 10 ADM/show, but the title stays below a 10 ADM/show site-day average by Day 4.
coming.nug: The app-to-the-dead hook is instantly legible and contemporary; its edge is clarity, while conversion from awareness remains unproven.

lanes.read: A grieving man uses a mysterious application to reconnect with his murdered girlfriend, but instead admits a malevolent force that exploits his grief and desire for revenge.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF provides the complete premise, character identities and supernatural threat.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is clear enough for positioning as contemporary supernatural horror with romance and revenge elements.

lanes.read: Junior Roberts and Dosma Hazenbosch lead, with Della Dartyan, Ruth Marini, Aldo Irawan Putra and Aulia Deas supporting; NIH Pictures is the public-facing production brand, while LSF identifies PT. Nirwana Indah Hakarya.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF directly lists the cast and legal production entity; fetched release coverage consistently uses NIH Pictures.
lanes.decision_consequence: The recognizable leads support campaign visibility, but the package does not establish star-driven ticket demand.

lanes.read: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the strongest adjacent account calls it tense through the ending and describes psychological horror plus action-thriller, but no clearly independent critic or audience review validates that assessment.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Teknogav offers a positive feel description, but its production quotations and promotional framing weaken its independence.
lanes.missing_fact: A clearly independent post-screening review or attributable audience reaction addressing execution, scares, pacing and satisfaction.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not treat claimed intensity or genre blending as a quality premium; keep the film in monitor status until audience evidence arrives.

lanes.read: Accessible digital-horror hook: an app connecting the living and dead gives the film a contemporary premise, while romance, revenge and action broaden the pitch; the 17+ rating narrows the addressable audience.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF verifies the supernatural-app premise and 17+ classification; release coverage consistently positions it as urban supernatural horror.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat it as a clearly marketable genre title, but not as a broad-family or demand-backed opener.

lanes.read: Active but localized campaign: NIH Pictures released trailer and poster, Dimas Anggara and Dosma Hazenbosch attended a Palembang special screening, and gala-premiere content appeared immediately before release.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Detik directly reports the Palembang special screening with Dimas and Dosma; captured TikTok samples show gala and release-week promotion.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect some release awareness from appearances and campaign activity, but do not convert that activity into a demand assumption.

lanes.read: Visible but campaign-led social response: ten captured TikTok results total 11,029 views, 319 likes, seven comments and 93 shares; one post supplies 90 of the shares, and the sample contains little organic audience discussion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The strongest post recorded 3,050 views, 136 likes, two comments and 90 shares, while most other posts generated minimal comments or sharing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Count this as narrow awareness with concentrated sharing, not broad engagement or purchase intent.

lanes.read: Demand remains insufficient evidence: release-date posts say to add the title to a TIX ID watchlist or secure tickets, but the bundle contains no bookable showtime, presale volume, seat map, sell-out or paid-admission signal.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Promotional TikTok calls to action are the closest purchase-adjacent evidence, but they contain no observable transaction response.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified presale or booking data, bookable SAMS showtimes, seat movement, or paid opening-day admissions.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not grant an ordinary exploration floor from public signals; demand must be learned from verified booking or paid-admission evidence after eligibility is confirmed.

lanes.read: Programming risk outweighs the public signal: private SAMS ordinary eligibility remains unconfirmed, purchase demand is absent, quality is unvalidated and the 17+ rating limits reach despite an active campaign.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The supplied title record leaves private eligibility unresolved; LSF verifies the 17+ restriction and captured social evidence remains promotional rather than transactional.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title outside the confirmed ordinary slate until Programming clears eligibility; if cleared, judge it as a monitored genre release rather than a demand-backed commitment.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Mixed: premise, cast, rating and campaign are verified; independent quality and private eligibility are not.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Gated: SAMS public Coming lists approval, but private booking, DCP and ordinary eligibility remain unconfirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Absent: TIX ID watchlist and ticket prompts show calls to action, not bookings, seat movement or paid admissions.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active but narrow: 10 TikTok posts drew 11,029 views; one supplied 90 of 93 shares, with only seven comments.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: 17+ limits reach; quality, paid demand and private eligibility remain unverified despite active promotion.
ai_rating.actionability: Observe and learn: confirm eligibility, then measure paid ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 and through Day 4.

eligibility.basis: The title appears on the SAMS public Coming surface with is_approved=true, but that public indication is discovery evidence only and is not private booking, DCP or final ordinary-eligibility confirmation. No explicit current Akhil or Programming confirmation was supplied.

coming.meta: Andovi da Lopez; Cahaya Pictures and Studio Antelope: directed by Fajar Nugros, with Claresta Taufan, Benedictus Siregar and Soleh Solihun.
coming.logline: A calculating gubernatorial candidate is cursed to speak without lies or filters, throwing his campaign, family and carefully managed public image into comic chaos.
coming.quality: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the captured material supports a light, topical and potentially abrasive political-comedy feel, but no readable independent review actually evaluates execution, laughs, pacing or performances.
coming.gold: Accessible topical hook, uncertain conversion: a familiar honesty curse localized to Indonesian electoral culture gives the comedy an easy marketing frame, while political associations may narrow or polarize interest.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign, not quality proof: a media screening, press conference, trailer/poster rollout, ticket messaging and frequent short-form cast content were all visible before release.
coming.social: Visible but campaign-led engagement: the ten-post TikTok sample peaked at 46,132 views and 3,228 likes, while most sampled posts were much smaller and the sample cannot represent total audience demand.
coming.demand: Purchase access exists, demand does not: tickets were reported available and a third-party page displayed release-day schedules, but no verified paid presales, seat movement, sell-outs or SAMS-local intent were captured.
coming.risk: Polarization and eligibility risk: hostile political readings are documented, and no private SAMS booking, DCP or ordinary-eligibility confirmation is present, so publicity cannot safely become an allocation claim.
coming.bet: If privately eligible, Day 1 curiosity should be visible, while Day 4 retention will depend on comedy execution and word of mouth.
coming.nug: Instantly legible but execution untested: the honesty curse gives Indonesian electoral comedy an accessible hook, with political readings adding polarization risk.

lanes.read: A calculating gubernatorial candidate is cursed to speak without lies or filters, turning his campaign, family life and carefully managed public image into comic chaos.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: FilmIndonesia and ANTARA describe Jonas Prakoso as a candidate whose inability to lie and filter his thoughts destabilizes his campaign and personal life.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is immediately legible and marketable as topical political comedy without requiring franchise knowledge.

lanes.read: Recognizable comic lead and ensemble: Andovi da Lopez fronts a Cahaya Pictures and Studio Antelope production directed by Fajar Nugros, with Claresta Taufan, Benedictus Siregar and Soleh Solihun.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA directly names Andovi da Lopez, the supporting ensemble, Fajar Nugros and both production houses.
lanes.decision_consequence: Talent and production identity support awareness, but they do not establish a demand floor or justify broad opening allocation.

lanes.read: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the captured material supports a light, topical and potentially abrasive political-comedy feel, but no readable independent review actually evaluates execution, laughs, pacing or performances.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched tvOne article describes the 103-minute premise and thematic ambition but supplies no clear positive or negative critical judgment despite its review headline.
lanes.missing_fact: A genuinely independent post-screening assessment of comedic execution, pacing, performances and overall audience satisfaction.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not award a quality-led allocation premium; treat tone as promising positioning rather than proof that the film works.

lanes.read: Accessible topical hook, uncertain conversion: a familiar honesty curse localized to Indonesian electoral culture gives the comedy an easy marketing frame, while political associations may narrow or polarize interest.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA reports deliberate Indonesian localization, while IDN Times records accusations that the film favored a political camp.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position it as broad character comedy rather than partisan satire and consider only a measured test until demand becomes observable.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign, not quality proof: a media screening, press conference, trailer/poster rollout, ticket messaging and frequent short-form cast content were all visible before release.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A fetched report confirms the October 6 media screening and press conference, while the captured social sample shows repeated release and ticket calls to action.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect baseline awareness support, but do not translate campaign volume into additional shows without purchase or performance evidence.

lanes.read: Visible but campaign-led engagement: the ten-post TikTok sample peaked at 46,132 views and 3,228 likes, while most sampled posts were much smaller and the sample cannot represent total audience demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: One October 10 post featuring Pramono Anung reached 46,132 views, 3,228 likes, 67 comments and 35 shares; other sampled posts ranged from 2,859 to 34,737 views.
lanes.decision_consequence: Credit the title with directional awareness and some interaction, but apply no ticket-demand uplift from social metrics alone.

lanes.read: Purchase access exists, demand does not: tickets were reported available and a third-party page displayed release-day schedules, but no verified paid presales, seat movement, sell-outs or SAMS-local intent were captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Fajar Metro reports tickets available across booking platforms; JadwalNonton displays specific October 15 Jakarta sessions but no transaction or occupancy evidence.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified paid presales, seat-map movement, sell-outs, advance revenue or opening-day ordinary admissions, especially for SAMS-relevant markets.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title at insufficient evidence for an ordinary exploration floor; first confirm private SAMS eligibility, then let observed sales or ordinary admissions earn expansion.

lanes.read: Polarization and eligibility risk: hostile political readings are documented, and no private SAMS booking, DCP or ordinary-eligibility confirmation is present, so publicity cannot safely become an allocation claim.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: IDN Times records politically framed attacks on the teaser and lead talent; captured public evidence establishes release activity but not private SAMS readiness.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use politically neutral positioning and make no ordinary allocation commitment until Programming confirms site-level eligibility and delivery readiness.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Strong identity and campaign evidence: no independent verdict on comedy, pacing, performances or satisfaction.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Public Coming listing only: private booking, DCP and ordinary eligibility remain unconfirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Purchase routes exist: no verified presales, seat movement, sell-outs or SAMS-local intent were captured.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active campaign, uneven response: one sampled post reached 46,132 views; most were smaller and campaign-led.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Politically hostile readings are documented: controversy is not evidence of broad rejection or weak demand.
ai_rating.actionability: Clear observation gate: confirm private eligibility, then measure ordinary ADM/show and occupancy on Day 1 and Day 4.

eligibility.basis: The title is absent from the captured SAMS public Coming in-window list, but that public surface is not private eligibility truth. No explicit current Akhil or Programming confirmation of ordinary SAMS eligibility was supplied.

coming.meta: Donny Damara, Denira Wiraguna; production house unverified: Ivan Bandhito directs, Leni Lolang produces, with Wulan Suandhini in the principal cast.
coming.logline: After her family moves into an inherited old house, Harum finds a mysterious shawl and must uncover the unjust death behind a vengeful dancer’s escalating terror.
coming.quality: Current-film quality is unproven: the premise supports a conventional supernatural mystery, while the only captured qualitative praise comes from participating actor Donny Damara rather than an independent review.
coming.gold: Accessible but undifferentiated horror package: an 87-minute domestic horror-thriller with a direct supernatural hook and familiar cast is schedulable, but the 17+ rating and absent purchase signal limit the upside case.
coming.promo: Active launch publicity, not proven conversion: the film held an October 8 gala premiere at XXI Epicentrum and generated cast-focused coverage ahead of its October 15 release.
coming.social: Narrow cast-fandom visibility: title-matched TikTok samples include Gisellma Firmansyah edits and gala-premiere posts, with one sample reaching 5,917 views and 427 likes, but comments and shares were minimal.
coming.demand: Ticket demand remains unproven: captured sources confirm the October 15 cinema release, but provide no presale, seat-fill, sold-out, booking-volume or audience purchase evidence.
coming.risk: Conversion risk is the dominant commercial concern: the visible social pocket is mostly cast-fandom content with little conversation, while the 17+ restriction narrows access and no direct buying signal offsets those limits.
coming.bet: If eligible and booked, cast-led awareness will not reach 10 ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 or sustain it through Day 4.
coming.nug: Accessible but undifferentiated: an 87-minute supernatural mystery with familiar cast, while visible traction remains cast-fandom rather than ticket intent.

lanes.read: After her family moves into an inherited old house, Harum finds a mysterious shawl and must uncover the unjust death behind a vengeful dancer’s escalating terror.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Film Indonesia’s captured synopsis directly describes the family’s move, the mysterious shawl and Harum’s attempt to solve the dancer’s death.
lanes.decision_consequence: The clear supernatural-mystery premise is easy to communicate, but premise clarity alone does not justify an ordinary booking floor.

lanes.read: Donny Damara and Denira Wiraguna provide the most commercially recognizable cast anchors, with Ivan Bandhito directing and Leni Lolang producing; the production house remains unverified.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured coverage identifies Donny Damara, Denira Wiraguna, Wulan Suandhini, director Ivan Bandhito and producer Leni Lolang.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable primary or fetched source explicitly naming the production house.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the cast as a modest recognition cue, but do not assign producer or production-house reputation credit until the company is verified.

lanes.read: Current-film quality is unproven: the premise supports a conventional supernatural mystery, while the only captured qualitative praise comes from participating actor Donny Damara rather than an independent review.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Gala-premiere coverage quotes Donny Damara describing the film as complete in drama and scares, but no independent critic or audience assessment was captured.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent review, screening assessment or attributable audience reaction evaluating the completed film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not upgrade the title for presumed quality; treat early ordinary admissions and audience response as the first credible quality test.

lanes.read: Accessible but undifferentiated horror package: an 87-minute domestic horror-thriller with a direct supernatural hook and familiar cast is schedulable, but the 17+ rating and absent purchase signal limit the upside case.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured listings verify the horror-thriller genre, 87-minute duration, 17+ classification, October 15 release and recognizable cast.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep it as a conditional genre option rather than a priority title, pending private eligibility and evidence of actual ticket conversion.

lanes.read: Active launch publicity, not proven conversion: the film held an October 8 gala premiere at XXI Epicentrum and generated cast-focused coverage ahead of its October 15 release.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A fetched event report directly records the gala premiere at XXI Epicentrum on October 8 and interviews Donny Damara.
lanes.decision_consequence: Credit the campaign with a functioning launch beat, but do not treat premiere coverage as evidence that audiences are buying tickets.

lanes.read: Narrow cast-fandom visibility: title-matched TikTok samples include Gisellma Firmansyah edits and gala-premiere posts, with one sample reaching 5,917 views and 427 likes, but comments and shares were minimal.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured TikTok sample shows several title-linked cast edits and premiere posts; the strongest had 5,917 views, 427 likes, two comments and three shares.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the activity as evidence of a small cast-fan awareness pocket, not broad conversation or ticket intent.

lanes.read: Ticket demand remains unproven: captured sources confirm the October 15 cinema release, but provide no presale, seat-fill, sold-out, booking-volume or audience purchase evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The strongest adjacent evidence is a dated theatrical listing; social samples show attention around cast and premiere content rather than purchase behavior.
lanes.missing_fact: Presale volume, advance seat occupancy, sold-out sessions or another direct ticket-purchase indicator.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not infer an exploration floor from publicity or release proximity; require private eligibility and judge any booking through early ordinary ADM/show.

lanes.read: Conversion risk is the dominant commercial concern: the visible social pocket is mostly cast-fandom content with little conversation, while the 17+ restriction narrows access and no direct buying signal offsets those limits.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The best title-linked TikTok sample drew 5,917 views but only two comments and three shares, and the fetched film listing assigns a 17+ rating.
lanes.decision_consequence: If Programming confirms eligibility, keep exposure bounded and demand an early performance read rather than protecting the title on publicity alone.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Mixed: release facts are verified; quality has only participant praise, with no independent review.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Eligibility unresolved: public SAMS absence is not private truth, so the meeting cannot treat it as bookable.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: No purchase signal: October 15 is verified, but no presale, seat-fill, sold-out or booking-volume evidence exists.

ai_rating.actionability: Observe and learn: confirm private eligibility, then measure uncontaminated ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 and Day 4.

coming.meta: Baskara Mahendra, Yasamin Jasem and Imperial Pictures: supported by Tanta Ginting, Chika Waode, Leony VH and Mathias Muchus; directed by Arie Aziz.
coming.logline: An indigo mortuary cosmetician helps the demanding ghost of an influencer investigate her suspicious death within 40 days.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: the premise and lead chemistry received favorable premiere coverage, but the captured praise came from the executive producer rather than an independent critic or ordinary audience.
coming.gold: Accessible but not demand-backed: the R13, roughly 100-minute horror-comedy combines a familiar supernatural genre with a distinctive mortuary-cosmetician and influencer mystery.
coming.promo: Visible launch activity, limited activation proof: Ghosthing held a Senayan City XXI gala premiere on 9 October after earlier press coverage, but no captured roadshow, community activation or ticket offer was verified.
coming.social: One encouraging but narrow TikTok result: a title-specific Baskara post reached 69,250 views, 7,212 likes, 84 comments and 274 shares; most other results, especially Instagram, were polluted by generic dating-ghosting content.
coming.demand: Ticket demand has insufficient evidence: no verified presale level, seat movement, sold-out showing or purchase-intent response was captured; the strongest adjacent signal is one engaged cast-led TikTok post.
coming.risk: Execution and conversion risk remain material: the director identifies balancing comedy, horror and mystery as the creative challenge, while independent quality, ticket intent and private SAMS ordinary eligibility remain unresolved.
coming.bet: If eligible and played ordinarily, its distinctive premise may draw curiosity but average below 10 ADM/show without local activation.
coming.nug: The R13, roughly 100-minute horror-comedy gives a familiar genre a distinctive mortuary-cosmetician and influencer mystery hook.

lanes.read: Clear supernatural mystery-comedy: an indigo mortuary cosmetician helps the demanding ghost of an influencer investigate her suspicious death within 40 days.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: JawaPos describes Alfian, Maya, their reciprocal bargain and the 40-day investigation.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is easy to communicate and gives the room a specific audience proposition rather than generic horror.

lanes.read: Recognizable leads, smaller production banner: Baskara Mahendra and Yasamin Jasem headline the Imperial Pictures film, supported by Tanta Ginting, Chika Waode, Leony VH and Mathias Muchus.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple readable reports independently identify the same two leads, supporting cast and Imperial Pictures.
lanes.decision_consequence: Lead recognition and an experienced ensemble help positioning, but the production house alone does not justify a strong allocation.

lanes.read: Quality remains unproven: the premise and lead chemistry received favorable premiere coverage, but the captured praise came from the executive producer rather than an independent critic or ordinary audience.

lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review or attributable post-screening audience assessment of the finished film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the film's tone as promising creative packaging, not evidence for a quality-led booking or expansion.

lanes.read: Accessible but not demand-backed: the R13, roughly 100-minute horror-comedy combines a familiar supernatural genre with a distinctive mortuary-cosmetician and influencer mystery.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: JawaPos reports the R13 classification, approximately 100-minute runtime and horror-comedy investigation premise.

lanes.read: One encouraging but narrow TikTok result: a title-specific Baskara post reached 69,250 views, 7,212 likes, 84 comments and 274 shares; most other results, especially Instagram, were polluted by generic dating-ghosting content.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured social sample contains one clearly title-specific TikTok post with meaningful engagement and one smaller relevant post, while unrelated results dominate the wider sample.

lanes.missing_fact: Verified advance-booking activity, seat movement, presale volume or another direct purchase-proximity measure for Ghosthing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not claim demand, confirm a booking, or assign an ordinary exploration floor from this bundle; private SAMS eligibility must also be resolved first.

lanes.read: Execution and conversion risk remain material: the director identifies balancing comedy, horror and mystery as the creative challenge, while independent quality, ticket intent and private SAMS ordinary eligibility remain unresolved.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Arie Aziz directly describes tonal balance as the film's main challenge; captured research supplies no independent verdict or verified purchase signal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title in research and use conservative conditional planning only; no confirmed booking claim or ordinary exploration floor is justified yet.

attention_heading: Three conclusions that should move the room

attention.label: Resolve eligibility before reading demand
attention.why: All four incoming titles lack confirmed private booking, DCP and ordinary eligibility; absence or non-play cannot be interpreted as rejection.
attention.action: Confirm ordinary eligibility and context; if unresolved, mark the title NOT_TESTABLE rather than weak.

attention.label: Separate reach from conversion
attention.why: GHOSTHING and BAPAK PALING JUJUR show visible campaign response, but neither has verified presales, seat movement or paid admissions.
attention.action: Judge conversion through uncontaminated ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 and Day 4.

attention.label: Challenge the network-average story
attention.why: Current SAMS results range sharply by title and site, so one network average can conceal both exceptional and weak local outcomes.
attention.action: Use the actual title-site matrix and isolate special contexts before carrying any lesson forward.

what_milo_sees.title: GHOSTHING
what_milo_sees.insight: GHOSTHING owns the clearest engagement-shaped signal: 7,212 likes on one 69,250-view title-specific TikTok. Its distinctive horror-comedy hook makes it the cleanest conversion test, not a proven demand winner.

non_consensus_hypothesis.title: GHOSTHING
non_consensus_hypothesis.hypothesis: If both titles are ordinarily eligible, GHOSTHING will exceed DENDAM ARWAH PENARI on weighted ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 and remain ahead through Day 4; GHOSTHING is also more likely to cross 10 on both windows.
non_consensus_hypothesis.evidence: GHOSTHING combines an R13 rating, a differentiated horror-comedy mechanism and one deeply engaged title-specific post. DENDAM ARWAH PENARI has a more familiar supernatural proposition, a 17+ restriction, shallow documented conversation and no offsetting purchase signal.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_non_consensus: The cautious consensus would classify both as unproven horror openings and wait. The sharper test is that proposition distinctiveness and accessibility should create a measurable conversion gap even though neither title has purchase evidence.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_stronger_than_alternative: DENDAM ARWAH PENARI could benefit from genre familiarity and cast affinity, but its evidence shows little conversation and no purchase signal. GHOSTHING has a clearer differentiating mechanism and less restrictive rating; no superiority is inferred from unlike social volumes.
non_consensus_hypothesis.falsifier: Falsified if both are eligible and DENDAM ARWAH PENARI matches or exceeds GHOSTHING on weighted ordinary ADM/show on both Day 1 and Day 4. If either is unbooked or materially context-contaminated, the test is NOT_TESTABLE.

evidence_to_measure: Capture the Programming room's actual title-by-site matrix after it is frozen, covering 240 shows across 16 SAMS-owned sites.
For each title-site pair, compare actual shows with Day 1 and Day 4 admissions and ADM/show; treat missing evidence as missing, not zero.
Keep NOBAR, NOMAT, EVENT, SUPPORT, and PROMO rows separate from ordinary demand before interpreting results.
Reconcile site-title totals to title summaries for each observation and quarantine any conflicting embedded denominator.

applied_priors.application: Treat current Playing observations as evidence only; carryover status and explicit owner obligations must be resolved separately before any later allocation decision.
Frame learning at title-site level because network averages mask substantial local variation; no network-wide carryover conclusion is drawn.
